summary: Infobird Co., Ltd filed a Form 6-K on August 25, 2026, disclosing the immediate resignation of CEO, chairperson, and director Xiangyang Wen on August 24, 2026. Yaqing Wei was appointed CEO, chairperson, director, and committee member the same day, with her biography and employment agreement included. The abrupt departure and same-day replacement signal a sudden leadership transition. The employment agreement is attached as Exhibit 10.1. What to watch: management continuity, strategic direction under new CEO, and any subsequent filings regarding board changes or corporate actions.
